title: Pilaf and Zesty Oatmeal Breakfast Bowl
description: A hearty breakfast bowl made with pilaf, oatmeal, and a hint of zesty flavor.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
Add the pilaf and reduce heat to a simmer. Cook until the pilaf is tender and fluffy.
In a separate saucepan, bring the milk to a simmer.
Add the oatmeal and cook, stirring constantly, until the oatmeal is creamy and cooked.
Stir in the zesty seasoning and honey.
To assemble the breakfast bowl, place the cooked pilaf in the bottom of a bowl.
Top with the cooked oatmeal mixture.
